definition: Waffles is a collection of command-line tools for performing machine learning operations developed at Brigham Young University.
details: These tools are written in C++, and are available under the GNU Lesser General Public License.

explainer.lead: Waffles is a collection of command-line tools for performing machine learning operations, developed at Brigham Young University. The tools are written in C++ and released under the GNU Lesser General Public License.

tiers.eli5: It is a set of ready-made commands you can run to do machine learning tasks without writing everything yourself.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use the command-line tools to run machine learning operations in scripted pipelines. Being command-line based, it favors batch-style workflows over interactive use.
tiers.paperLevel: A C++ collection of command-line machine learning tools from Brigham Young University, available under the GNU Lesser General Public License.

explainer.example: A pipeline can invoke the tools as commands to perform machine learning operations within a script.
